scope: Read-only payload and baseline scaling audit; writes only QA evidence, no release asset or implementation source edits.
byte_measurement: Exact on-disk file bytes read and SHA-256 hashed. No HTTP/content-encoding overhead, viewer/module payload, GLB decode/render cost or device measurements are included.
selection: Exactly the ten assets in assets/manifest.json and their selected posters/sequence routes in assets/turntables/index.json. Historical unselected revisions and old 320px sequences are excluded.

catalog.numeric_sort_retained_heap_limit: min(total, page * pageSize + pageSize); can reach the whole catalog on a deep numeric-sort page
catalog.cache_bound_caveat: Eight-shard LRU does not bound all transient data. Numeric sorting retains selected summaries outside that cache; facet/shard descriptors also grow with catalog size.
catalog.metadata_concurrency: Tests observe peak 1 separately for summary and detail lanes; this is not a single global metadata request cap.

dom.verification: Grid and map caps are source-inspected. Pure atlas geometry was tested separately; no browser DOM or hardware-GPU assertion is made by this audit.

baseline_model_stage.verification: Source inspection only here; no live model draw or physical-device performance claim.

interpretation: The GLB-only interactive payload is 54.49% smaller than all 24 frames in aggregate; all ten individual GLBs are smaller than their full selected sequence.

The baseline loads only a current frame and neighbors, not the whole sequence. All ten GLBs are larger than their initial three image frames; brief-hover bandwidth and cold-start latency cannot be inferred from the full-sequence comparison.
The static poster is a common initial fallback cost in both designs. Poster and frame 0 are byte-identical but use different URLs; ordinary URL caches need not deduplicate their transfer.

A shared one-model renderer preserves the possibility of bounded GPU resources but does not prove low frame time. The selected conifer release explicitly retains SwiftShader frame-budget failures and device-specific acceptance.
Historical 3,828,934 frame bytes and 164,604 poster bytes in docs/image-scrub-preview.md describe an older checkpoint, not these current mixed-release assets.
This audit does not certify the subsequently implemented shared-model-preview controller; its lifecycle, interruption, fallback, DPR, network, DOM and GPU behavior require its own final tests.
